title: party-visuals bundle config (cfg/party-visuals.json)
description: NodeCG serves this config to every page of the bundle, so it holds no secret: the lightshow token lives in the file lightshow.tokenFile names.

url.description: The lightshow server: http(s)://host:port, with no token or credentials in it.

tokenFile.description: A file holding the lightshow's access token and nothing else, read by the extension only. Relative to the folder NodeCG runs from. Empty: the lightshow has no token (a loopback bind).

pollMs.description: How often GET /api/state is polled while the socket is down.

maxMs.description: The longest wait: the doubling stops here.

maxFps.description: The most frames a second a graphic draws.

offsetMs.description: Shift the graphics' beat: positive draws it earlier, to make up for a projector's or OBS's delay. Judge it on the real screen.

allowHosts.description: Host names the api/ addresses answer to besides IP addresses, localhost and *.local (Companion calling this machine by name).
